new.source: Self-hosted Release build of the same pinned VMR RC2/main production source as the third-wave campaign

framework.compiler_gc: Server GC and very-large-object support, matching desktop fsc configuration
framework.allocation_api: AppDomain.MonitoringTotalAllocatedMemorySize: current compiler AppDomain, all threads; ARM enabled
framework.path_support: Native longPathAware manifest; required to read the unchanged 260+ character source paths. No source/path rewriting.

design.scope: Two compatible compiler/Core payloads crossed with three runtimes. Identical payload DLLs across runtimes; same frozen compiler/IDE inputs as prior campaigns.
design.native_images: IL payloads throughout this factorial: no R2R or NGen. Do not pool with shipping SDK/R2R cohorts.
design.order: Six-treatment Williams design: base [0,1,5,2,4,3], add round modulo six to each index; two complete blocks
design.exclusions: One failed FsAutoComplete warmup (old-net11, round -2) is preserved separately: the NuGet FCS deployment lacked default.win32manifest. The identical SDK10 resource was deployed before restarting the complete FsAutoComplete cohort. No successful observations are excluded; pilots and calibration remain separate.
design.allocation_controls: Paired ARM on/off classic-host runs, outside primary cohorts; off means allocation not collected, not zero.

applications.source: Unchanged Kernels.fs, eight kernels and six sizes
applications.target: netstandard2.0; compiled once per payload on classic Framework, then the identical DLL runs on all three runtimes
applications.gc: Ordinary application defaults (workstation GC); no server-GC override

qualifications: This is an x64 FCS-host experiment, not Visual Studio or the 32-bit desktop fsc executable.
Allocation APIs differ across CLR families; calibrated known allocations and retired worker threads establish accounting bounds.
Shared-machine timings are descriptive. Framework ARM instrumentation is explicitly identified.
The new source is the previously pinned VMR-main-equivalent snapshot, not an unpinned moving main branch.

Executable compilation requires default.win32manifest beside FCS. The SDK10, new source payload and Framework fallback copies are byte-identical (SHA256 C0085EB467D2FC9C9F395047E057183B3CD1503A4087D0DB565161C13527A76F). Deployment was corrected without changing inputs, arguments or frozen binaries.
Application launch order rotates runtime pairs with old/new AB/BA/AB order; three launches do not provide full six-position balancing.
